datasheet_identity.title: SS22B THRU SS220B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER (SMB Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet SS22B-SS220B; SS24B is the 40 V member: VRRM = VDC = 40 V and VRMS = 28 V (p. 1). IF(AV) = 2.0 A and IFSM = 50 A at 8.3 ms half-sine are common ratings.
Table merged cells assign VF maximum 0.55 V at IF = 2.0 A to SS22B-SS24B; IR1 maximum 1.0 mA at VR = VDC, Ta = 25 degC to SS22B-SS210B; CJ typical 220 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz to SS22B-SS24B (p. 2).
Fig.3 SS22B-SS24B forward trace was digitized from the printed linear-voltage/log-current grid; plotted values are recorded in SI amperes.
Fig.1 and Fig.2 are thermal/surge rating curves and were not digitized. Fig.4 is a normalized reverse-characteristics plot and was not used as an absolute-voltage curve.
No reverse recovery time or measured avalanche/breakdown row is published. VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown voltage, so breakdown fields are null.
